family.schneider-l38616.description: The 16 MHz Schneider desktop with a key lock.
family.schneider-l38616.history: Schneider covered the L 386/16 and EuroSX in one service manual. The L 386/16 used the 16 MHz EuroSX board in its own chassis with a key lock. The manual distinguishes HD 60 and HD 80 configurations. The December 1991 German list names it LAN-Station and offers 80 MB for DM 3,517 net. The same list offered a diskless option for DM 1,990 net.
